Bolo vulcão Choconinho 😍 Gente, só digo uma coisa pra vocês, SALVEM E FAÇAM ESSA RECEITA!! Ficou surreal 😍 Ingredientes:  3 ovos  1/2 xícara de óleo  1 xícara de açúcar  1 xícara de leite  1 colher de chá de essência de baunilha  3 colheres de sopa de chocolate em pó 50%  2 xícaras de farinha de trigo  1 colher de chá de bicarbonato de sódio  1 colher de sopa de fermento  Modo de preparo:  No liquidificador acrescente os ovos, açúcar, essência de baunilha, leite, óleo e chocolate em pó, bata por 2 minutos, acrescente a farinha de trigo, o fermento e o bicarbonato, bata por 30 segundos no máximo ( não bata demais). Unte uma forma com furo no meio com manteiga e chocolate em pó e despeje a massa, asse em forno pré aquecido à 180 graus por 45-50 minutos, espere esfriar e desenforme.  Cobertura:  1 lata de leite condensado  2 caixinhas de creme de leite  6 colheres de sopa de leite em pó  150 gramas de chocolate branco  Misture tudo muito bem e leve em fogo médio, quando levantar borbulhas desligue o fogo e jogue por cima do bolo, peneire leite em pó e aproveite! Fica sensacional de gostoso 🤤😍 Gostaram?  #bolo #chocolate #brigadeiro #bolovulcao #massa #recheio #confeitaria #receita #sobremesa #doce #fy

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

SINGLE SERVE MOLTEN CHOCOLATE LAVA CAKE 🌋 Grab the recipe below ⬇️  * 1/4 cup semisweet or dark chocolate chips (~1.7oz) * 1 tablespoon unsalted butter * 3 tablespoons white granulated sugar * 1 egg * 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract * 2 tablespoons all purpose flour, spooned and leveled * Pinch kosher salt 1. Preheat your oven to 425°F and well grease a large ramekin with butter (mine was 10 ounces to top rim and about 4.25 inches wide) and dust with cocoa powder. Make sure to do this generously, especially on the bottom, so the cake easily releases. 2. Melt the chocolate chips and butter. You can do this in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second intervals, stirring in between each one, until melted. Set aside to cool. 3. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the sugar, egg, and vanilla until combined and foamy. Then whisk in the flour until smooth. 4. Add the cooled, melted chocolate and gently fold/stir until combined. 5. Pour the batter into the greased ramekin and bake for 13-15 minutes. The edges will be set and it will be slightly puffed in the middle but the middle will still feel soft if you gently press on it. Do not over bake or you lose that ‘lava’ texture. 6. AIR FRYER VARIATION - Air fry at 370 degrees for 8-10 minutes. The edges will be set and it will be puffed in the middle but the middle will still feel soft if you gently press on it. Do not over bake or the molten center will cook and lose that ‘lava’ texture.  7. After baking, run a knife around the edges to loosen it and let it rest for 3-4 minutes before trying to remove. Place a plate over the ramekin and carefully flip it upside down. Wait for about 20-30 seconds before lifting up the ramekin and the cake should remain on the plate. 8. I like to dust with a little powdered sugar and/or serve with a scoop of ice-cream. Enjoy immediately while still warm. #singleservedessert #singleserverecipe #singleservecake #chocolatelavacake

Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie
